floorPlan.note: Aligned to user-marked ZONE_FLOOR (SketchUp face painted with ZONE_FLOOR material). Origin = its min corner. Zones extracted via tools/glb-prep/extract-zones.mjs.
floorPlan.placeableAreas: 2 polygons (green) from ZONE_FLOOR = size-rectangle minus restricted zones; furniture confined here
floorPlan.note2: Real floor is non-rectangular & disconnected (left L + right rectangle). The hall outline is an L, 4420×2540 minus the shortened passage.
floorPlan.note3: planSizeCm.width runs to 6051 because the raised reception deck (ZONE_KABALAT_PANIM, x 4432…6051, +470cm) shares this plan space. The hall alone is 4423 wide.

ceilingBeams.note: Lighting-truss grid, read off the 72 HalfCoupler clamps in the SKP (72 = 36 crossings × 2 = 9 × 4 × 2). All clamp centres at z=9.097m.

cameras.note: 7 SketchUp Scenes. Cameras do NOT survive the GLB export (inspect-cameras.mjs reports 0) — they are read from the SimLab session's Scene nodes and converted via (x, z, 24.861 − y). Values live in src/core/venuePacks.ts.
